scenes.vo: Last night, the thing outside my door knew I was reading my phone.
I didn't sleep. I sat with my back against the closet, waiting for the sun. That's when I felt the scratches.
Someone had carved words into the inside of the closet door. Small, shaky letters. Signed, NORA. The tenant before me.
Rule one. It knocks at three. It can't open the door. You have to. Rule two. Never answer. If it hears you, it learns your VOICE.
Rule three was carved deeper than the others. Never look when the peephole is DARK. It's looking back.
Below that, the letters got messy, like she wrote them in the dark. Nora's last line said: It learned my VOICE.
